C 87-115's native-Windows arm is dead on this target and its body needs <windows.h>'s FILETIME and ULONGLONG, which this target has not got, so the arm's tokens are recorded here instead of written out (the rawmemchr.c CHERI-arm class); C 96's `if (!initialized) initialize ()` and the FILETIME arithmetic are that arm's.  C 118's `# if !defined OK_TO_USE_1S_CLOCK / # error` arm (likewise dead: HAVE_GETTIMEOFDAY is 1) carries none of these tokens.  `otv`, `timeval` and `timezone` come from C 121-124's `# if defined timeval` arm, which the frozen configuration's table leaves undefined, so C's `# else` arm - the direct call - is the live text the port writes
C 63-64's `static_assert (…)` carries the two `sizeof` comparisons; the port writes them as `const _: () = assert! (…)` (the memclear static_assert class), so the macro's keyword has no counterpart
